sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.lead: Last updated: October 2026

data.body:
## Information we collect

When you contact us through this website, we collect the details you provide: your name, organization, email address, area of interest and message. We use privacy-conscious analytics that do not use advertising cookies, so we can understand aggregate site usage.

## How we use it

We use your information only to respond to your inquiry, manage the resulting business relationship and improve this website. We do not sell personal information.

## Sharing

We share information only with service providers that help us operate this website (for example, hosting), under appropriate confidentiality obligations, or where required by law.

## Retention

We keep inquiry information only for as long as needed for the purposes above, or as required by law.

## Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information by emailing [info@somdigitaldome.com](mailto:info@somdigitaldome.com).

## Product privacy

SomSpot, Shifaa, Fagaaro and SomSoft each have their own privacy terms covering use of those products.

seo.title: SomSpot | Find Local Businesses in Somalia | Digital Dome
seo.description: SomSpot is a local business discovery platform for Somalia. Find restaurants, shops, clinics, hotels and services near you, and help your business get found.

items.title: The problem
items.text: Most local commerce in Somalia is found through word of mouth and scattered social-media posts. There is no reliable, structured, up-to-date source for what exists, where it is and how to reach it. Consumers waste time, and good businesses stay invisible.

items.title: Our solution
items.text: SomSpot gives every business a structured, searchable profile with location, hours, contact options and photos, designed around how Somali neighborhoods and landmarks actually work.

items.title: Consumers
items.text: Residents and visitors searching for restaurants, shops, clinics, hotels, services and places.

items.title: Local businesses
items.text: SMEs that want to be found, build trust and reach new customers without building their own website.

items.title: Service providers
items.text: Tradespeople and independent professionals who rely on referrals today.

sections.title: Simple for users. Valuable for the market.

items.title: Businesses list
items.text: Owners claim a free profile with location, hours, contacts and photos.

items.title: People search
items.text: Search by category, neighborhood or need, in Somali or English.

items.title: Connect instantly
items.text: Call, message or get landmark-based directions in one tap.

items.title: Businesses grow
items.text: Upgrade to promoted placement, richer profiles and customer insights.

sections.title: How SomSpot makes money
sections.lead: Mobile connections already cover 58.1% of the population, and only 27.6% of people are online (DataReportal, 2026). As more people come online, demand for structured local information grows with them. The first platform to build trusted local data has a durable advantage.

items.title: Promoted listings
items.text: Businesses pay for priority placement in relevant searches and categories.

items.title: Advertising
items.text: Targeted display placements for brands reaching local audiences.

items.title: Business subscriptions
items.text: Premium profiles, analytics and multi-location management.

items.title: Leads & bookings
items.text: Fees on qualified leads or bookings once volume justifies it.

items.title: Built for Somali geography
items.text: Landmark and neighborhood-based discovery, not only street addresses.

items.title: Somali-first language
items.text: A native Somali experience with English support.

items.title: Mobile-money aware
items.text: Profiles show which payment methods a business accepts.

items.title: Light by design
items.text: Optimized for low-bandwidth connections and entry-level smartphones.

sections.title: Next milestone: Business onboarding & city beta
sections.lead: Seed the directory with verified listings in a launch city, then open a public beta.

items.question: What is SomSpot?
items.answer: SomSpot is a local business discovery platform for Somalia. It helps people find businesses, services and places, and helps businesses get found by new customers.

items.question: How can my business be listed on SomSpot?
items.answer: Businesses will be able to claim a profile with their location, opening hours, contact options and photos. To register early interest, contact Digital Dome through this website.

items.question: Does SomSpot work in Somali?
items.answer: Yes. SomSpot is designed as a Somali-first experience with English support, and it is optimized for low-bandwidth connections.

seo.title: Shifaa | Find Trusted Ruqyah Practitioners in Somalia | Digital Dome
seo.description: Shifaa connects people in Somalia and the diaspora with vetted Ruqyah practitioners and related services, with private booking and mobile-money payment.

items.title: The problem
items.text: Finding a credible practitioner today depends on informal referrals. People have little visibility into a practitioner’s background, availability or fees, and privacy is a real concern. Good practitioners have no professional way to be found or to manage bookings.

items.title: Our solution
items.text: Shifaa provides vetted practitioner profiles, clear service information, private booking and mobile-money payment, built with cultural and religious sensitivity.

items.title: Individuals & families
items.text: People seeking Ruqyah and related services for themselves or a relative, at home or abroad.

items.title: Practitioners
items.text: Ruqyah practitioners who want a professional, trusted channel to manage clients and sessions.

items.title: Related services
items.text: Complementary providers serving the same community need.

sections.title: Simple for users. Valuable for the market.

items.title: Browse
items.text: Explore practitioner profiles with services, languages, location and availability.

items.title: Book privately
items.text: Request an in-person or remote session with discreet communication.

items.title: Pay simply
items.text: Pay securely with mobile money.

items.title: Build trust
items.text: Feedback helps the community identify trusted practitioners.

sections.title: How Shifaa makes money
sections.lead: This is a culturally specific service category that global platforms do not address. Combining mobile-money payments (used by about 73% of Somali adults, per the World Bank) with diaspora demand for remote sessions creates a focused, defensible niche.

items.title: Booking commission
items.text: A fee on each session booked and paid through the platform.

items.title: Practitioner subscriptions
items.text: Professional profile tools, scheduling and featured placement.

items.title: Related services
items.text: Extending to adjacent community and wellbeing service categories.

items.title: Culturally grounded
items.text: Designed with respect for religious and community norms.

items.title: Practitioner vetting

items.title: Privacy-first
items.text: Discreet booking and communication by default.

items.title: Diaspora reach
items.text: Remote sessions connect families abroad with trusted practitioners.

sections.title: Next milestone: Practitioner onboarding & pilot

items.title: Our solution
items.text: Fagaaro gives hosts a simple way to create free or paid events, sell access with mobile money and engage audiences live through Q&A, interaction and replays.

items.title: Public figures

items.title: Organizations
items.text: Community groups, NGOs and businesses running webinars, town halls and launches.

items.title: Audiences

items.text: Somali organizations run on paper, spreadsheets and disconnected tools. International vendors are expensive, remote and rarely understand local workflows or mobile-money payments. Local options are often one-off freelance work with no long-term support.

items.title: Our solution
items.text: SomSoft by Digital Dome combines local market understanding with modern engineering. It delivers custom systems today and turns repeated client needs into scalable SaaS products for key sectors.

items.title: Businesses
items.text: Retailers, hotels, logistics companies and growing SMEs that need reliable systems.

items.title: Institutions & NGOs
items.text: Schools, clinics and non-profits that need digital operations and reporting.

items.title: Government & enterprise
items.text: Organizations undergoing digital transformation that need a dependable local partner.

items.question: What does SomSoft by Digital Dome do?
items.answer: SomSoft builds custom software, mobile apps, websites, business systems, cloud solutions, mobile-money integrations and AI tools for organizations in Somalia, and provides ongoing support.

items.question: Can SomSoft integrate mobile-money payments?
items.answer: Yes. Mobile-money integration is one of SomSoft’s core services.

items.question: Which sectors does SomSoft serve?
items.answer: SomSoft works with businesses, NGOs, institutions, government and enterprises. It is developing repeatable SaaS products for hotels, clinics, schools, retail, logistics and property management.

news.title: Introducing Digital Dome
news.summary: Digital Dome is a technology company building four digital products for Somalia and the wider Somali market: SomSpot, Shifaa, Fagaaro and SomSoft.
news.body:
Digital Dome is building technology platforms and software products designed around the realities, behavior and opportunities of the Somali digital economy.

## Four products, one ecosystem

- **SomSpot** helps people discover local businesses, services and places.
- **Shifaa** connects people with trusted Ruqyah practitioners and related services.
- **Fagaaro** lets public figures and organizations host paid or interactive digital events.
- **SomSoft by Digital Dome** builds software, websites, systems and SaaS for businesses and institutions.

## Why now

Somalia has one of the youngest populations in the world, and mobile money is already part of everyday life. Many of the local digital services that could be built on top of that foundation do not exist yet. Digital Dome was formed to build them.

## What comes next

We will use this page to share product launches, milestones and partnership news as they happen. Investors and partners can reach us through the [Investors & Partners](/investors/) page.
